_how: Built from day3/design/validation-rules-shrivatsa.md. Rule ids match the paper design. Rule types: day3/rules/RULE_TYPES.md.

file_rules.why: A renamed or missing column breaks every rule after it: reject the whole file.

rules.why: Nothing to settle or trace without them.
A malformed PNR cannot be traced back to the booking.
Catches shape errors such as AIR separately from unknown carriers.
An unknown carrier has no ticket prefix to settle against.
Catches lower-case, digits and multi-letter values as format errors.
A booking class the carrier does not publish cannot be priced or settled.
The airport rules cannot run on a malformed pair.
An unverified route cannot be settled.
A ticket from an airport to itself is not a valid journey.
Avoids a rounding decision on money; amounts are Decimal, never float.
An issue file should not carry zero or negative fares.
An unknown currency cannot be converted or settled.
Malformed tickets are caught as format before the prefix check.
A ticket numbered for another carrier would be settled against the wrong airline.
One agreed format avoids day/month ambiguity.
A ticket cannot be issued after the file that reports it.
Valid revenue is still settled, but a person can see it was late.
Without a valid agency the sale cannot be attributed to an agent.
Same ticket twice in one file: keep the first, skip and count the repeat.
